integrative_lead.hypothesis: candidate SigK-regulon / ufaA1-lipid-neighbourhood associated component, to validate
integrative_lead.real_gene: conserved (snp_sites=2/145209, 0 nonsense/frameshift, non-pseudogene), MS-detected, globular (pLDDT ESM 92 / AF 82.8), 221 aa; DUF1365
integrative_lead.adversarial: skeptic not refuted. ufaA1 STRING fusion/cooccurrence downgraded as operon co-inheritance artefact (same fact as neighbourhood); operon heterogeneous (ufaA1 cyclopropane-lipid vs sigK/rskA sigma cassette) -> no single pathway; Foldseek #1 = engineered Anticalin (eukaryotic design artefact), all hits non-significant; no M-CSA.

canettii.interpretation: low power (1 canettii-consensus substitution(s)); present in M. canettii but dN/dS not reliable
canettii.source: M. canettii (immediate outgroup, 153 genomes) vs H37Rv, Nei-Gojobori dN/dS over the >=50% canettii-consensus substitutions (annotation_mtbc P10)

ntm.interpretation: conserved across the genus (present in 31/53 non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes, incl. distant relatives) — an ancient core gene predating the genus radiation
ntm.source: presence/absence by tblastn vs ~53 assembled non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes (annotation_mtbc P10.2)

phylostratum.interpretation: detected across the order Corynebacteriales (Corynebacterium/Nocardia/Rhodococcus/…) but not in more distant Actinomycetia — a Corynebacteriales-level gene
phylostratum.source: cross-genus phylostratigraphy: tblastn vs 13 non-Mycobacterium reference genomes (Mycobacteriaceae>Corynebacteriales>Actinomycetia>outside-phylum) + intra-genus NTM presence (annotation_mtbc P10.3)

literature.category_label: no TB publication mentions this locus tag
literature.summary: No TB publication mentions this locus tag in its title or abstract (sweep of a ~330k-abstract PubMed TB corpus). This gene is genuinely unstudied: its darkness reflects absence of investigation, not failure of investigation.
literature.caveat: An antigen status or a virulence phenotype is NOT a molecular function: the verdict stays unchanged. This layer adds the missing context, it does not requalify the gene.
literature.source: PubMed (whole), MULTI-ALIAS sweep of title+abstract: the H37Rv locus tag AND every ortholog identifier (M. bovis Mb…, M. marinum MMAR_…, M. smegmatis MSMEG_…, M. leprae ML…, M. abscessus MAB_…), each hit VERIFIED against the abstract text (word-boundary regex). phase73, 2026-07-13

disorder.caveat: A property (biophysics), not a function. No LLPS/condensate claim is made from disorder alone. Verdict unchanged.
disorder.source: metapredict v3 (Emenecker/Holehouse) per-residue disorder + AlphaFold mean pLDDT (annotation_mtbc P16.13)
